title: Idempotent webhook delivery with durable claims
prompt: A webhook receiver uses SQLite to avoid processing the same event twice. It currently marks events done before the handler succeeds, so retries are lost; duplicate deliveries can also race. Fix process_event(db, event_id, payload, handler) in webhook.py. Return True only when this call handled the event, False for an already completed event. Roll back claims on handler failure, preserve a completed result across new connections, and avoid duplicate handler execution for sequential duplicate deliveries. Run tests and validate.
